name: TRADFRI LED driver, 10 w (ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2)
config_flow_discovery_remarks: Select this profile only if the printed driver type is ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2. The shared Home Assistant identifier may also match IL-1. Select the driver revision and connected load you actually have.
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks: Choose the measured YTBERG 1.5W combination (1x, 2x, 3x or 4x) matching your connected lights. Each measurement includes the driver and all connected lamps. For other lights, select 'Virtual power (manual)' and enter their minimum and maximum power, excluding the driver's own consumption. Leave the fields empty to track only the driver.
